title: ProtocolSchema
description: Schema root keeps every independently consumable value in definitions.

DatasetTransition.description: One turn-based multi-agent transition. Session ID is fixed to 1 within a log. `next_actor` names the next observer, which may differ from `actor`.

final_observation.description: The last next-player observation at an external cutoff, for value bootstrapping. Natural termination and continuing steps keep this None.

EndReason.description: Completed is a core match end; Truncated is the configured operation limit; Interrupted is an explicit earlier stop by the caller.

final_observation.description: The final next-actor observation at a time limit, for value bootstrapping. Natural match ends and ongoing transitions have no final observation.

LogRecord.description: One JSONL record. Full and public formats have disjoint headers and bodies. Deserializing a record alone is not replay validation: use `replay` for that.

PublicAction.description: Reaction choices remain private until the core resolves them. The public view then shows only the selected meld or round result, not rejected choices.

PublicAiConfig.description: Deliberately has no seed field. Even an AI's private random seed is omitted.

Viewer.description: TOML has no null: both transports use a seat number or the explicit string "public".
